nodes.label: Backup file format v1
nodes.rationale: Import order parses, checks version, bounds KDF iterations (100k-5M), decrypts, validates with Zod, and only then replaces local data.

nodes.label: Encrypted backup behavior spec
nodes.rationale: Never silently substitute plaintext export; implement encrypted path correctly or defer visibly.

nodes.label: Dashboard Phase 1 screen spec
nodes.rationale: Truthful zero/empty states; never fabricate jobs, referrals or activity.

nodes.label: Phase 1: static app shell, dark UX, local profile
nodes.norm_label: phase 1: static app shell, dark ux, local profile

nodes.label: Public-site and privacy warning
nodes.rationale: Pages sites are public even from private repos; no frontend-only password screen; never commit personal data.

nodes.label: Encrypted backup export/import
nodes.rationale: AES-256-GCM with PBKDF2-SHA-256 (600k iterations); lost passphrase cannot be recovered.

nodes.label: Privacy model (public site, local data)
nodes.rationale: GitHub Pages is public with no login; profile stays in browser IndexedDB, no sync, no analytics, encrypted backups only.

nodes.label: Profile readiness score
nodes.rationale: Deterministic fixed weighted checklist rather than AI-generated; weights in src/domain/profile/readiness.ts.

nodes.label: Phase 1 status: app shell and local profile (done)
nodes.norm_label: phase 1 status: app shell and local profile (done)

nodes.label: Architecture decisions table
nodes.rationale: Static SPA on Pages with no backend; hash router since Pages cannot rewrite paths; Zod on every read/write/import; standard Web Crypto only; no web fonts/CDN; no analytics or VITE_* secrets because the bundle is public.

nodes.label: Definition of success
nodes.rationale: Architecture must stay honest: Pages cannot provide a private server, live backend or cross-device sync.

nodes.label: GitHub Pages architecture constraints
nodes.rationale: Pages serves static files only, so any backend need is a separate architectural decision.

nodes.label: What we are explicitly not building
nodes.norm_label: what we are explicitly not building

nodes.label: Product vision
nodes.rationale: Optimize for relevant interviews secured, not number of listings collected.

nodes.label: JobIntel Product, UX and Implementation Plan
nodes.norm_label: jobintel product, ux and implementation plan

nodes.label: Core product principles
nodes.rationale: Evidence over guesses, local-first data, static-hosting-first, no secrets in browser, human approval for external actions, useful after every phase, cost-conscious.

nodes.label: Job discovery pipeline
nodes.rationale: Per-source isolation with timeout and retry; GITHUB_TOKEN pushes do not trigger workflows so scan.yml calls pages.yml itself.

nodes.label: feedSchema.ts shared contract
nodes.rationale: Imported by both collector and app so each side validates the same contract.

nodes.label: Future job-discovery on GitHub Actions
nodes.rationale: Schedules can be delayed and disabled after 60 days of inactivity; use Asia/Kolkata timezone and off-hour minute offsets.

nodes.label: Closed job detection and 14-day pruning
nodes.rationale: A job missing from a healthy source is marked closed; a failing source never closes its jobs.

nodes.label: Decisions and learning (IndexedDB v2 jobActions)
nodes.rationale: Learning is applied at read time in the browser so decisions are never published.

nodes.label: Source layers (app, components, features, domain, storage, styles)
nodes.norm_label: source layers (app, components, features, domain, storage, styles)
nodes.rationale: UI holds no business rules; only storage/ touches IndexedDB via a typed repository.

nodes.label: IndexedDB storage and migrations
nodes.rationale: Append-only migration steps; invalid stored records trigger restore/clear offer instead of silent discard.

nodes.label: Phase 3: job intelligence and matching engine
nodes.norm_label: phase 3: job intelligence and matching engine
nodes.rationale: Weighted deterministic score (skills 30, experience 20, responsibility 20, location 10, seniority 10, other 10) computed in the browser so the profile stays local.

nodes.label: Approved dark blue/cyan visual direction
nodes.rationale: Minimalist, developer-oriented, dark-only; the earlier purple direction was rejected.

nodes.label: HashRouter routing
nodes.rationale: Refreshing a deep link never returns a 404 on Pages.
